swus.primary_behavior: Encode public-safe red and green editorial-admission fixtures without changing runtime behavior.
swus.acceptance_boundary: Corpus parses, expected reasons exist, controls exist, and the private sweep is empty.
swus.split_analysis: Red, green, and baseline evidence only become causal when reviewed together.
swus.done_criteria: Generic fixture corpus and honest not-enforced baseline exist.
swus.acceptance_evidence: Fixture inventory, parse result, privacy sweep.

swus.primary_behavior: Validate a run-receipt envelope with four non-substitutable evidence axes.
swus.acceptance_boundary: Positive and negative schema fixtures return expected results without status policy.
swus.split_analysis: Schema and fixtures are jointly required for reviewable closure.
swus.done_criteria: Schemas parse and fixture expectations hold.

swus.primary_behavior: Compute final status as the strictest applicable gate.
swus.acceptance_boundary: Table tests cover each reason, combined reasons, and non-substitution.
swus.split_analysis: All rules are rows of one pure precedence function.
swus.done_criteria: Exact ceilings and reason codes match all controls.
swus.acceptance_evidence: Evaluator report with candidate result flag.

swus.primary_behavior: Admit human evidence only for exact artifact, surface, and approval kind.
swus.acceptance_boundary: Ambient and substitution controls fail while exact controls pass.
swus.split_analysis: All bindings are conjuncts of one admissibility decision.
swus.done_criteria: All exact-scope binding fixtures match expected outcomes.

swus.primary_behavior: Compute pre-generation permission for full derivatives.
swus.acceptance_boundary: Volatile, unapproved, and unaccounted cases block; bounded audition/exact trial classify correctly.
swus.split_analysis: State, approval, and surface ownership are conjunctive inputs to one permission decision.
swus.done_criteria: Admission decision runs before derivative creation and passes all fixtures.

swus.primary_behavior: Validate a role-complete first surface for a candidate newcomer technical explainer.
swus.acceptance_boundary: Complete generic manifest passes profile validation and incomplete/private/promotion controls fail.
swus.split_analysis: Profile, roles, and examples are one usable transport contract; rendering is excluded.
swus.done_criteria: Candidate profile, complete/incomplete fixtures, and privacy sweep pass.
swus.acceptance_evidence: Profile validation report and candidate status flag.

swus.primary_behavior: Account for each new audience block and keep retell validation-only by default.
swus.acceptance_boundary: Unowned, invalid replacement, rendered validation-only, and unjustified retell cases fail.
swus.split_analysis: Retell is the high-risk specialization of one surface ownership policy.
swus.done_criteria: Surface ownership fixtures pass without semantic uniqueness claims.

swus.primary_behavior: Apply one append-only correction transaction that invalidates current readiness and updates state/routing.
swus.acceptance_boundary: Replay proves append-before-project, idempotency, history preservation, volatility, and reflect routing.
swus.split_analysis: Partial transaction success would make history and current state contradictory.
swus.done_criteria: Correction replay and emitted signal fixture pass.

swus.primary_behavior: Migrate one host-local preset across canonical native regeneration without loss or leakage.
swus.acceptance_boundary: Local resolution, generated drift, and public privacy checks all pass after regeneration.
swus.split_analysis: Extraction, discovery, and regeneration must close atomically to avoid data loss or stale behavior.
swus.done_criteria: Local preset survives regeneration and private content is absent from public Arcanum.
swus.acceptance_evidence: Generation receipt, local resolution test, diff, privacy sweep.
swus.validation_surface: Task file verification commands plus actual bootstrap command resolved at execution time.

exempt_tasks.reason: Closure-only VERIFY task with no feature behavior mutation.
